data.description:
## Description
**What**: Build a synthetic end-to-end test covering the twelve SC9 scenarios (a) extraction+atomic write+audit, (b) skip recorded, (c) privacy redaction, (d) lookup stale-example exclusion, (e) frequency graduation with accept + PR + promoted tag, (f) frequency collapse (>=80% similar -> 1 signal), (g) cross-slug predicate graduation, (h) theme-only rejection, (i) sycophancy empty-answer block + challenged-rejected, (j) cold-start/empty-corpus omit-section, (k) ranking-tie deterministic lexical order, (l) operational metric emission of RETRO_TELEMETRY with all named counter fields.
**Why**: This is the integration proof that the closed-loop system works end to end across all four phases.
**Scope**:
- IN: twelve-scenario synthetic fixtures and assertions wiring draft-1..7 together.
- OUT: the individual unit behaviors (covered by draft-1..7).

## Done Definitions

- An integration test exercises the record->lookup->graduate->lifecycle loop in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no environment variables pre-set from the developer's machine) and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-9
- The test asserts scenarios (a) extraction+atomic write+audit, (b) skip recorded, (c) privacy redaction, and (d) lookup stale-example exclusion each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9
- The test asserts scenarios (e) frequency graduation with accept+PR+promoted tag, (f) frequency collapse to one signal, (g) cross-slug predicate graduation, and (h) theme-only rejection each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9
- The test asserts scenarios (i) sycophancy empty-answer block marking challenged-rejected, (j) cold-start empty-corpus omitting the learned-patterns section with excluded_count=0, (k) ranking-tie deterministic lexical order, and (l) RETRO_TELEMETRY emission with all named counter fields each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-9

## Considerations

- [Testing] SC9 is VALIDATION-CLASS / live-verified — the loop must be exercised against real ticket-CLI primitives and a synthetic fixture gh branch, not mocked-out internals, in a configuration-isolated environment.
- [Dependency] This story integrates draft-1 through draft-7; it must run after all of them land.
- [Operational] Scenario (e) and (l) exercise the gh PR-creation path on a synthetic fixture branch per the epic operational-constraints in-session verification.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a synthetic end-to-end test exercising all twelve calibration scenarios, so that the full record->lookup->graduate->lifecycle loop is verified in one configuration-isolated run.
